answer: An admission auction stops sybil floods in an orchard-management network: each applicant bids a 10 POA deposit for one work slot, the highest bids win, and deposits return only after verified work. A sonnet-writing agent competes on equal terms, so a faker cannot clone a winner for free. Creating 100 fake identities locks 100 x 10 POA, or 1,000 POA, while an honest agent locks 10 POA once. Each identity keeps a thread of verified jobs, so honest workers build standing cheaply while fake volume stays expensive.
